decisionsTitle: „Email respins” says which email, why and what to do, where the club looks (amending §663, §650)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-07**, on the production registrations list of the 21 November race — two cards «Confirmată», «Unde a ajuns: 5/6 · Loc confirmat», race numbers given, one address at a public webmail, each with the red chip «Email respins» and «RETRIMITE QR»: «Cum e posibil să fie email respins dar și confirmat? Am nevoie de mai multe info in app».

The data decision, „The runners' own emails tell the truth”, made the stored facts true: only the participant's own messages count, Mailgun's deliveries and real reasons are kept, and each registration has one email state — `unreachable` (nothing has reached the address since a refusal: the call list), `not-sent` (the club's Mailgun account refused it on 1–2 October), `missing` (the address works again but this email, still needed, never arrived), `retried` (sent again, waiting) — with the cause of the refusal. This decision draws it where the owner looks, a 360–400 px phone first, and gives the club's own mailboxes their own place. **The principle: flag a runner only when somebody must act; say which email, when and why in plain words; name the press that clears it; the whole story one tap away.**

**Decision.**

1. **Words by cause, one pure module** (`registrations/ui/rejected-email-words.ts`, rewritten, the data decision's reader rule and its combination table kept and extended). Each of the eleven causes has a label of at most four words — «Adresa nu există» («Adresa nu mai există» when the address answered the person's own click before the refusal: «A mers la confirmare (…); acum serverul spune că nu există — poate și-a închis căsuța.»), «Căsuța e plină», «Blocat la destinatar», «Eșuat temporar», «Refuzat definitiv», «Mailgun nu mai trimite», «S-a dezabonat», «Marcat ca spam», «Oprit: marcat ca spam», «Nu a plecat», «Motiv necunoscut» — a «why» sentence in plain words, and a to-do by cause and by reader. **The reader rule stays**: the Administrator is told the press that clears it by its button's name; the Organizer «Roagă un administrator să…» for a resend (§289) but «Sună persoana: …» for a call, like the Administrator; the desk what to say to the person in front of it, «Spune-i persoanei: …», never to phone (§67). **On a confirmed registration the to-do opens with «Locul rămâne confirmat; la masă îl găsiți după nume.» and never suggests a new registration** — on a full race a new one goes to the waiting list; the person changes the address only by a new registration (§645), and that is said only while the registration is not confirmed. A full mailbox: «Roag-o să-și facă loc în căsuță.», then the press. Blocked, gave up, refused, other: «Nu e neapărat adresa; poate merge mai târziu.», then the press. Suppressed: Mailgun sends nothing until the address is removed from Mailgun → Suppressions — only if the person confirms it is right. Unsubscribed: never lifted unless the person asks. **The event's notices** — «Detalii actualizate» and the cancellation, which no press sends again (`callInstead`) — end, whatever the cause, with the call: «Sună persoana: …» for the Administrator and the Organizer after the cause's sentence (for an address that does not exist the call is the to-do itself, «Sună persoana» once), «Spune-i persoanei: …» at the desk; a blocked server or a full mailbox no longer leaves a cancellation with nobody told to phone. The club's account: «Nu a plecat atunci (contul clubului era refuzat de Mailgun), nu din cauza adresei.», then the press. Every string under 200 characters, both catalogues.
2. **Short names** (`Admin.emails.typesShort`): every participant message and the club's three in the participant's words — «Confirmarea cu QR», «Numărul de concurs», «Confirmă adresa», «Linkul de declarație», «Reminderul», «Detalii actualizate»…; the long `Admin.emails.types` names stay for the registration page's story.
3. **The list (card on a phone, row on a laptop)**: «Email respins» and its tooltip island left the list. One line under the name and its chips instead, itself a link to the registration's «Emailuri» — 44 pixels, the filter's glyph, body weight, `flexBasis: 100%` so it sits under the bold name, not among the chips: red «{cause} · {short name} · {day}» for an address that refuses mail; amber «{short name} lipsește · adresa merge acum» for an email owed to an address that works again, and «Nu a plecat · {short name} · {day}» for one the account could not send; nothing for an email sent again. The day is the day and the month alone, in club time — «26 sept.», no weekday, no year, no hour: with §452's weekday, «Adresa nu există · Confirmarea cu QR · sâm., 26 sept.» measured 329 px against the 310 a 400-pixel phone leaves it, and took two lines. Each part unbreakable (non-breaking spaces inside it), so that line takes one line at 400 px and wraps between parts at 360 px, two lines at most — the e2e measures both widths. The list is lighter: a plain link per flagged row, no client island. The filter reads «Doar cu un email respins (n)» with the count the data decision provides, and its help says whom it keeps.
4. **The registration's page**: the header chip went. Under the address, the same line (a link to `#emailuri`) and one to-do sentence by reader. **«Emailuri»** replaced «Istoric email» and moved after the verbs, so the resend presses stay where the thumb finds them: open by itself only while somebody must act; the whole story first (the long name, when, why, whether the address had been confirmed, the provider's code — once, before words that do not start with it — and redacted words in small print); then every email newest first, two short lines each — «{short name} · către participant» / «Livrat sâm., 3 oct., 10:15», «Trimis», «În coadă», «Trimis prin Gmail · fără confirmare de livrare», «Respins — {cause}», «Marcat ca spam», «Nu a plecat — {reason}», «Retrimis de {staff}» on a resend by hand; under a refusal, the code, the words, why and what came after. The participant's own first five in view, the rest behind «Toate emailurile (n)»; the club's (the archive, the notice, the copies) behind «și cele către club (n)», by role and never by a club mailbox's address. One legend: «Trimis» is handed to the provider, «Livrat» reached the receiving server (perhaps its Spam), delivered emails are deleted after 90 days and deliveries before this release were not recorded — no date, since a deployment records them only once it runs this code and Mailgun's «Delivered» webhook is set.
5. **«Ce îi spui»** names the email in the participant's words and its date, the cause in plain words and what they can do («Fă loc în căsuță și îți retrimitem.», «Adaugă adresa clubului în contacte și îți retrimitem.», «Am oprit trimiterile după un refuz; spune-ne dacă adresa e bună.»), and on a confirmed registration always «Locul tău e confirmat; la masă te găsim după nume.»; nothing for an email sent again or a family member's owed one.
6. **Every resend question** — the list's «Retrimite QR» and «Retrimite familiei», the page's «Retrimite emailul» and «Trimite reminderul», «Retrimite declarația tuturor care nu au semnat» — opens, while the address refuses the club's mail, with what the last refusal means for the press: Mailgun will not send (a suppression, an unsubscription, a complaint's suppression), the address does not exist, the mailbox was full that day, the server refused it for its own reason, or it was marked as spam; the bulk one says how many of those who wait to sign have such an address. Nothing for the account's refusal or an email owed: sending again is the right press. It never blocks the press; authorization stays on the server.
7. **The desk**: no chip unless somebody must act and the refused email is the QR confirmation (the confirmation, or the race number's email it carries — the cover map, and `render.ts`'s desk code) — this person's own, or any at an address that refuses mail; a family member's owed confirmation at the same address draws nothing, since this person's own may have arrived: «Fără QR pe email — caută după nume», and in its tooltip «Nu oprește ridicarea numărului.» and what to tell the person — for an address that refuses mail what its cause asks, for an email owed «Spune-i persoanei: emailul cu QR nu i-a ajuns; numărul îl ridică după nume.», never a press to ask for — from the desk's own projection, no address, no provider words (§67).
8. **The club's own side.** «Setări → Emailuri» has «Adresele clubului care resping emailuri», drawn only for the roles that read the registrations (`canReadRegistrations`, asserted on the server) and only when a club mailbox refused something in thirty days: per address — written only while it is still in «Copiile clubului», else the role's words alone — the role («arhiva declarațiilor», «Cc la arhivă», «anunțuri de confirmare», «Bcc la mesajele participanților»), the last refused message, its day and cause, the count in thirty days, and one thing to do; it opens by itself, with the amber border, only while an address still in the club's settings asks for something — one already removed says «nu mai e nimic de făcut» and asks for no attention. The club's account's refusals say nothing about a mailbox and are left out; a subscriber's, an invitee's, a colleague's or a runner's address is never read there. «Sarcini» carries three rows: a club mailbox refuses emails (red, linking the panel); Mailgun's «Delivered» events do not arrive — some of the participants' emails left by Mailgun this week and none was reported delivered — «Mailgun nu trimite evenimentele „Delivered”; fără ele, „Email respins” nu se stinge», with SETUP §35's steps and this deployment's values; and, per published event not ended, «{n} participanți la {event} au un email care cere atenție», linking its list filtered by the event and «Doar cu un email respins» — counted by that filter's own condition, whatever the registration's status, test registrations left out as from every count the club is given, so the row's number is the filter's. Its reads run side by side. «Echipa» marks a colleague's or a member's row whose newest invitation email was refused, until they sign in.
9. **Three leftovers of the data decision's last review.** A refusal written before migration `0131` has no `rejected_at`, so its instant is the queueing's: the state now says whether the instant is the refusal's own (`atKnown`), and only then do the words say «refuzat la trimitere», else «pus în coadă». A loop in the words' test that passed nothing to the words is gone. The desk no longer promises «un administrator o sună», which nothing tracks: it tells the person that the club's emails do not reach them and that only they can change the address, by a new registration — or, on a confirmed one, that their place stays.

**Refused.** A grey «cleared» chip on the list for a refusal that ended — the registration's «Emailuri» shows it, and a chip that asks nothing is the noise the owner complained of. A text column in the export — it would shift the export's positions and the club's own scripts; «Email bounced» stays «Yes» or empty for a state that asks somebody to act. A link inside a tooltip — unreachable by keyboard, and a tooltip closes under a thumb before the link is pressed. A chip on the desk for any email but the QR confirmation — the desk hands the number against the name either way, and the rest is the registration page's to say.

**Privacy.** No address reaches the list, the desk or «Sarcini»; a club mailbox's address is written only on «Setări → Emailuri», to those who read the registrations, and only while it is still in the club's settings. Nothing waits for the privacy notice: the screens read what the data decision already keeps.

**This amends** §663 (the chip and its tooltip on the list, the page and the desk) and §650 (the bounced tick, which now says its count).
changelogLine: - **«Email respins» says which email, why and what to do, where you look** — on the list one line under the name, «Adresa nu există · Confirmarea cu QR · 3 oct.», a link to the registration's new «Emailuri» (every email, newest first, the club's apart, the provider's words in small print); the to-do by cause and by who reads it, and on a confirmed registration first that the place stays; the filter says how many; every resend's question warns first when the address refuses mail; the desk shows one chip, «Fără QR pe email — caută după nume», for the QR confirmation only; «Setări → Emailuri» lists the club's own mailboxes that refuse emails, and «Sarcini» flags them, missing «Delivered» events from Mailgun, and each race with participants to see to. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration's page, then «Emailuri» — after the resend presses, at `#emailuri`, open by itself only while the email state asks somebody to act — tells the state's whole story (the email's long name, when, why by its cause, whether the address had been confirmed, the provider's code, once, and redacted words in small print), then lists every email newest first in two lines — its short name and whom it was for by role, and «În coadă», «Trimis», «Livrat», «Trimis prin Gmail · fără confirmare de livrare», «Respins — {cause}», «Marcat ca spam» or «Nu a plecat — {reason}» with its day, «Retrimis de {staff}» on a resend by hand — the participant's own five in view and the rest behind «Toate emailurile (n)», the club's archive copies, notices and copies behind «și cele către club (n)», never a club mailbox's address; under the address the list's line links to it with one to-do by reader (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Ce îi spui» on a registration whose address refuses the club's mail, then it names the email in the participant's words and its date, the cause in plain words and what the person can do — make room, add the club to the contacts, say whether the address is right — and on a confirmed registration ends «Locul tău e confirmat; la masă te găsim după nume.», never suggesting a new registration; an email owed is said as owed, a family member's owed email and an email sent again say nothing (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration whose address refuses the club's mail, when an Administrator opens «Retrimite QR», «Retrimite familiei», «Retrimite emailul» or «Trimite reminderul», then the question's first sentence says what the last refusal means for the press — Mailgun will not send (suppressed, unsubscribed, a complaint's suppression), the address does not exist, the mailbox was full on that day, the receiving server refused it for its own reason, or it was marked as spam — and «Retrimite declarația tuturor care nu au semnat» opens with how many of those who wait have such an address; an email the club's account could not send or one owed to an address that works again adds nothing, and no warning blocks the press (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list, then a row whose email state asks somebody to act carries one line under the name, a 44-pixel link to its «Emailuri» with the filter's glyph — red «{cause} · {short name} · {day}» for an address that refuses mail, amber «{short name} lipsește · adresa merge acum» or «Nu a plecat · {short name} · {day}» — each part unbreakable — the longest on one line at 400 px, two lines at most at 360 px — the day written as the day and the month alone (no weekday, year or hour), no provider words and no address; an email sent again draws nothing; «Doar cu un email respins (n)» says how many it keeps under the other filters (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the words of an email state, then every cause has a label of at most four words, a why and a to-do for each reader, every sentence under 200 characters: the Administrator told the press by its button's name, the Organizer to ask an Administrator for it and to phone where no press helps, the desk what to say to the person and never to phone; «Detalii actualizate» and the cancellation, which nothing sends again, end with the call whatever the cause (at the desk, what to tell the person); on a confirmed registration the to-do opens with «Locul rămâne confirmat; la masă îl găsiți după nume.» and never names a new registration; a refusal whose instant was not stored is said «pus în coadă», never «refuzat la trimitere» (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the desk, then a row shows «Fără QR pe email — caută după nume» only while its email state asks somebody to act and the refused email is the QR confirmation or the race number's email it carries — this person's own, or any at an address that refuses mail — its tooltip saying it does not stop the number being handed out and what to tell the person, for an email owed «Spune-i persoanei: emailul cu QR nu i-a ajuns; numărul îl ridică după nume.» and never a press; a family member's owed one and every other email show nothing, and the chip carries no address and no provider words (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Setări → Emailuri», then «Adresele clubului care resping emailuri» is drawn only for a role that reads the registrations, asserted on the server, and only when a club mailbox refused an archive copy, a confirmation notice or a copy in thirty days: per address — written only while it is still in «Copiile clubului», otherwise by its role's words alone — the role, the last refused message, its day and cause, the count and one thing to do, the panel open by itself and amber only while an address still in the settings asks for something; the club's account's refusals and any participant's, subscriber's, invitee's or colleague's address are never there (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Sarcini», then a club mailbox that refused the club's emails in thirty days is a red row linking «Setări → Emailuri», green after thirty quiet days; each published event not ended whose participants have an email that asks somebody to act has its own row «{n} participanți la {event} au un email care cere atenție» linking its list filtered by the event and «Doar cu un email respins», counted by that filter's own condition with test registrations left out; and «Echipa» marks a row whose newest invitation email was refused until the person signs in (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the participants' own emails that left by Mailgun in the last seven days, when none of them was reported delivered on a deployment that sends, then «Sarcini» shows the red row «Mailgun nu trimite evenimentele „Delivered”; fără ele, „Email respins” nu se stinge» with the webhook's steps and this deployment's address; it goes at the first delivery reported (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Email respins» says which email, why and what to do, where the club looks: one line on the list, «Emailuri» on the page, the club's own mailboxes
